mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 6.7% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days, reflecting labor market tightness and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in economic demand (GDPC1) and falling monetary policy rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a synergistic positive signal for S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur without the GDPC1-FEDFUNDS interaction pattern

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high supply growth (INDPRO) and low unemployment (UNRATE) drive positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive when in late-cycle with high INDPRO and low UNRATE

mechanism_narrative: A sudden inflation spike (CPIAUCSL crossing above 261.775) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors anticipate rate hikes and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX returns not negative when CPI spikes

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (HOUST) combined with falling monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) creates a positive signal for S&P 500 returns over 60 days, amplifying growth expectations.
failure_condition: Positive returns without the HOUST-FEDFUNDS interaction

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, low unemployment (UNRATE <5%) and ultra-low rates (FEDFUNDS <2%) drive positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as market recovers from crisis.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when in post-shock regime with low rates and unemployment

mechanism_narrative: A sudden payroll surge (PAYEMS crossing above 142,624) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as investors anticipate labor market overcapacity and reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX returns not negative when payroll jumps
